issues: Technical debt (not fixed, per DEC-003): truncate(text) with max omitted returns a suffix reading '[truncated NaN chars]' because max is undefined and text.length - undefined is NaN. A negative max also produces a misleading truncated-count message while silently dropping trailing characters. slugify(undefined)/slugify(null) throw TypeError since the function has no falsy-input guard (unlike truncate). None of these are encoded as tests and util.mjs was left unmodified.
output.summary: Created orchestrator/test/util.test.mjs with 15 flat node:test cases covering truncate() (falsy inputs, shorter/equal/longer than max, max=0, multi-line slicing) and slugify() (lowercase/hyphenate, punctuation collapse/trim, digits, idempotency, non-ASCII dropping, 'objective' fallback, default/custom max, and the mandatory trim-before-slice trailing-dash quirk for the 21-word input, plus an optional TypeError-on-undefined/null test documenting current behavior). npm test passes all 35 tests (including pre-existing guardrails/planner/routing suites); git status --porcelain shows a single untracked entry for the new file and zero modified files. util.mjs, package.json, and package-lock.json are untouched.
